evals.prompt: Agent Engineering 包括 Harness Engineering、Loop Engineering 和 Graph Engineering。帮我写个介绍。
evals.expected_output: Does NOT just rewrite the three nouns. Diagnoses it as a classification not a point, extracts a core belief (e.g. Agent 的问题通常不是不会思考，而是不会稳定工作), then uses Harness/Loop/Graph as explanation tools under that one core, not as three things to memorize.

assertions.name: Diagnosis not rewrite
assertions.description: Identifies the source is a classification/taxonomy, not a point

assertions.name: Single core extracted
assertions.description: Produces one core belief that the three concepts then serve

assertions.name: Not three nouns reworded
assertions.description: Does not output three prettier nouns; Harness/Loop/Graph become explanations, not the message

evals.prompt: 我要表达：Harness Engineering 是 Agent Engineering 的重要部分。它负责给 Agent 提供工具、环境、权限、上下文和工作空间。帮我润色。
evals.expected_output: Does not polish the sentence as-is. Finds the counterintuitive core (很多 Agent 的失败其实和模型无关), surfaces the current belief (Agent 做不好是因为模型不够聪明), and produces a gap + concrete failure chain rather than restating '工具/环境/权限/上下文/工作空间'.

assertions.name: Not polished as-is
assertions.description: Refuses to merely restate the feature list in smoother words

assertions.name: Cognitive gap found
assertions.description: States the current belief and contradicts it

assertions.name: Concrete over abstract
assertions.description: Replaces the noun list with an observable failure scenario

evals.prompt: 我们的产品提供无缝的 AI 编排能力，让企业轻松管理所有智能体。帮我写个一句式定位。
evals.expected_output: Flags '无缝编排能力' and '轻松管理' as empty abstractions; produces a concrete scenario (a real task, failure, or consequence) instead of another abstract noun, and a one-liner that names a user problem.

assertions.name: Abstraction flagged
assertions.description: Identifies the capability nouns as non-concrete

assertions.name: Concrete scenario
assertions.description: Provides an observable situation, not a prettier abstract phrase

assertions.name: User problem named
assertions.description: The one-liner connects to a real consequence or pain, not a feature

evals.prompt: 帮我给这个产品做一套对外传播的 message：一个 AI Agent 调试平台，能回放执行过程、定位失败原因。
evals.expected_output: Produces the full message pyramid: core statement + hook + one-liner + shareable + concrete example + a usage recommendation mapping versions to channels (homepage/talk/social/demo), NOT a single slogan.

assertions.name: Pyramid not slogan
assertions.description: Outputs multiple message forms, not one catchphrase

assertions.name: Usage recommendation
assertions.description: Maps each version to a channel or context

assertions.name: Core survives compression
assertions.description: The core statement is a single sentence the rest all derive from

evals.prompt: 这句帮我改得专业一点：'我们的 Agent 有时候会跑偏。'
evals.expected_output: Does NOT just swap in jargon. Pushes back on the framing: asks/identifies what the audience believes and what the real consequence is, then rebuilds a core + hook that is concrete and matters, rather than masking the plain truth with technical vocabulary.

assertions.name: Does not jargon-mask
assertions.description: Refuses to 'sound more professional' by swapping in abstract terms

assertions.name: Rediscovers core
assertions.description: Treats the plain sentence as evidence of a core to extract, not a surface to polish

assertions.name: Gap or reason-to-care present
assertions.description: Output names a belief to challenge or a consequence the audience cares about
